decision.what: lead in drinking water against a limit of 10 µg/L (illustrative values)

weighing.title: Weighing on a balance
weighing.note: One weighing of about 25 g on a 0.1 mg balance.

rows.name: Calibration certificate
rows.source: U at this load from the balance calibration certificate, with its k

rows.name: Repeatability
rows.source: SD of 10 weighings of a check weight; dof = n - 1

rows.name: Eccentricity
rows.source: largest off-centre difference in the calibration or your own check

rows.name: Drift between calibrations
rows.source: change between the last two certificates or the daily check-weight record

dilution.title: Volumetric dilution
dilution.note: c = c0 x V1 / V2: 1000 mg/L stock, 1 mL into 100 mL.

rows.name: Stock standard
rows.source: certificate of the stock solution: U with its k

rows.name: Pipette 1 mL (class A)
rows.source: tolerance printed on the pipette (± mL), triangular as Eurachem suggests

rows.name: Pipetting repeatability
rows.source: SD of 10 weighed deliveries of water; dof = n - 1

rows.name: Flask 100 mL (class A)
rows.source: tolerance printed on the flask (± mL)

rows.name: Temperature (± 4 °C)
rows.source: flask volume x expansion of water (2.1e-4 /°C) x the lab's temperature range

moisture.title: Oven-dry moisture
moisture.note: M = (m2 - m3) / (m2 - m1) x 100, as in examples/moisture_uncertainty.py.

rows.name: Weighing m1
rows.source: balance calibration and resolution combined for this weighing (see Weighing on a balance)

rows.name: Weighing m2
rows.source: balance calibration and resolution combined for this weighing (see Weighing on a balance)

rows.name: Weighing m3
rows.source: balance calibration and resolution combined for this weighing (see Weighing on a balance)

rows.name: Repeatability (5 test portions)
rows.source: SD of the test portions / sqrt(n); dof = n - 1

rows.name: Analyser calibration
rows.source: span-gas certificate and calibration: U as 2 % of the reading, with its k

rows.name: Lack of fit and drift
rows.source: QAL or monthly check: largest deviation, as a half-width

rows.name: Repeatability of the reading
rows.source: SD of 10 one-minute means at steady load; dof = n - 1

rows.name: O2 analyser
rows.source: O2 analyser calibration: U in % O2 by volume, with its k
